_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED BY THE PRE-CLOSE AND CORRECTLY STILL EMPTY - a check that ran, not a file that was skipped. The earnings calendar was re-pulled LIVE across 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-23 and NOT ONE of the twelve watched names appears anywhere in it - not SMCI, UPST, AMD, IONQ, RGTI, QBTS, LEU, SOUN, MARA, SMR, JOBY or OKLO. So the two duties this slot owes this file are both discharged by an empty list and both are recorded as having been performed: there is no catalyst whose date has passed to remove, and there is no carried spot to refresh - the failure mode this file exists to prevent, a reference price kept from the day it was written, cannot occur in a file with no rows in it. WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE 8/14 PRUNE: nothing about this file, and that is the point of writing the check down rather than the result. Friday's note recorded the board going flat into the weekend on OKLO's time stop; the board is flat again tonight, having specified one entry today that expired unfilled, so it carries no overnight position into Tuesday and therefore no dated event can catch it. This is the fifth consecutive session in which a live calendar pull has floored the entire watch list on the catalyst question rather than ranking it, and that streak is itself the finding: this board's universe has no dated events ahead of it, which is why every entry it has forced for a week has been forced on item 1. THE EMPTY FILE IS THE HONEST STATE. Rows would only be kept here to look busy, and an anticipated move that nobody anticipates is worse than a blank list.
